stem.text: A radioactive nucleus is formed by $\beta^{-}$ decay. This nucleus then decays by $\alpha$-emission.
Which graph of nucleon number $N$ plotted against proton number $Z$ shows the $\beta^{-}$ decay followed by the $\alpha$-emission?

A.alt: Graph of N against Z with axes labelled 88 to 94 and 230 to 236, showing two straight line segments joined by arrows.

B.alt: Graph of N against Z with axes labelled 88 to 94 and 230 to 236, showing two straight line segments joined by arrows.
